en.sayed-ali-raza: It is related that Hammām passed into a deep swoon and then expired.
Then Amīr al-mu’minīn said: Verily, by Allāh I had this fear about him. Then he added: Effective advices produce such effects on receptive minds.
Someone [2] said to him: O’ Amīr al-mu’minīn, how is it you do not receive such an effect?
Amīr al-mu’minīn replied: Woe to you. For death there is a fixed hour which cannot be exceeded, and a cause which does not change. Now look, never repeat such talk which Satan had put on your tongue.
